versions.description: Vote Restart — players vote democratically to restart the server. Dynamic threshold based on online non-immune players.
versions.configSchema: {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"voteDuration":{"type":"number","default":300,"minimum":10,"description":"How long the voting window stays open in seconds"},"cooldownDuration":{"type":"number","default":600,"minimum":0,"description":"Cooldown period in seconds after a failed/expired vote before a new one can start"},"restartDelay":{"type":"number","default":30,"minimum":0,"description":"Delay in seconds after vote passes before the restart command is executed"},"restartCommand":{"type":"string","default":"stop","description":"Raw game server command to execute when restart is triggered"},"passThreshold":{"type":"number","default":51,"minimum":1,"maximum":100,"description":"Percentage of online non-immune players needed to pass the vote"},"minimumPlayers":{"type":"number","default":2,"minimum":1,"description":"Minimum number of online non-immune players required to start a vote"}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false}

commands.name: voterestart
commands.description: Start a vote to restart the server
commands.helpText: Start a democratic vote to restart the server. Requires the VOTE_RESTART_INITIATE permission.

commands.name: votestatus
commands.description: Shows whether a restart vote is active, passed, or not running.
commands.helpText: Check the current status of the restart vote.

commands.name: voteyes
commands.description: Cast a yes vote for the current restart vote
commands.helpText: Vote yes for an ongoing server restart vote. No special permission required.

cronJobs.name: check-vote
cronJobs.description: Evaluate vote state every minute: check expiry, tally effective votes, and execute restart when delay elapsed

functions.name: vote-helpers

permissions.description: Allows a player to start a server restart vote with /voterestart
Excludes a player from the voter pool and denominator for restart votes
